items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Controls (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire tears (a direction key like Left fires, does not move); E places a bomb and decrements bomb HUD; wall hints list ITEM=Space (Space untested). HUD shows hearts, coins, bombs, keys, curse icon. Three hearts is full; hearts showing empty plus a pale ghost sprite at the top of the room indicated death (observed once).

Item/Tech X (observed): 'TECH X - Laser ring Tears' obtained twice, once from a red chest in a treasure room (earlier run) and once from a green/white pill floating above a rock in the two-poop room (this run). Firing spawns a stationary red laser ring ~100-150px ahead in the fire direction; it lingers and grinds down overlapping targets, then fades. Firing too close to a target makes the ring spawn past it; stand ~110px away. Sustained fire on one spot was needed to kill a blue fly. Laser is weak vs brown poop (barely damages, effectively resists) but blasts/bombs broke part of a poop pile. A golden-brown poop vanished on contact and gave a coin. Poop piles reappear/regenerate when re-entering rooms.

Chests (observed): a locked-looking gray/metal chest that opened neither by contact from above nor below was opened by firing tears into it, dropping a heart pickup (+1 heart) and a bomb-orb (+1 bomb). In an earlier run a gray chest opened on contact after its room's blue fly was killed. A red chest in a treasure room gave an item on contact. Touching a corner chest in the multi-chest room cost several hearts in one contact (possible mimic/spike chest - guess, unconfirmed). In the dark chest room the top-left red chest appeared tilted/opened with black spider enemies beside/near it (whether the chest spawned them is unconfirmed). HUD keys have consistently stayed 0; key-shaped floor sprites proved to be my own laser particles, not pickups.

Bombs (observed): E places; explosions damage the player (lost hearts each time when close) and destroy rock rings; a bomb against suspicious cracked/stained right-wall patterns did nothing (likely decorative). Retreat immediately after placing.

Hazards: black spider-like enemies in the dark chest room were lethal at 2 hearts and killed the player; they appear to be melee/chasers. White spike ring around a central red chest is likely damaging - whether it can be entered safely is unresolved. Diagonal rock chains block straight-line movement across a room; go around diagonally.

Transitions (observed): bottom gold trapdoors descend only when standing fully centered on them. Top gold crown hatches warp only when centered beneath and walking upward (side/offset approach does not trigger; sometimes needs extra nudging to center and a sustained W). Dark trapezoid doorways at top/bottom centers are ordinary room connections and need sustained walking into them to trigger. A right-wall doorway must be entered at its correct vertical band (roughly y 310-400 in the tutorial room); pushing right at other heights just presses the wall.

Map relationships learned: Tutorial room (wall hints, top/bottom dark trapezoid doors, right-wall doorway) - bottom door leads to the rock-ring gray-chest room (chest inside rock ring, bottom gold trapdoor); in an earlier run descending led to a red treasure chest room (gave Tech X), then further to a gray-chest room with torches/rocks/poop/blue fly, then to the two-poop room. Torch room (corner torches, diagonal rock chain, poop piles, scorch mark, top dark trapezoid door, bottom gold trapdoor): its top door loops back to the tutorial room; its bottom trapdoor leads to the two-poop room (central rock, two poop piles, gold crown hatch at top). The two-poop room's crown hatch returns up to the torch room. Rooms contain decorative pale rectangles and small gray floor marks that give no pickup (the pale rectangle persisted after contact - likely decorative). Tutorial room's right-wall doorway leads to the dark chest room: two corner red-lidded chests (top-left, top-right), black poop piles flanking a central red chest ringed by white spikes, and black spider enemies.

Failed strategies: walking into a locked-looking gray chest from above or below did not open it (shooting it did); firing while adjacent wasted the ring past targets; entering crown hatches from an offset position never warped; treating stationary floor key-sprites as pickups failed.

Active goals: survive; re-enter and clear the dark spider room, preferably damaging spiders at range with the laser ring rather than closing to melee; then investigate the top-right corner chest and the spike-ringed central red chest (contents/safety still unknown). Also remains open whether corner chests are mimics, whether the white spike ring can be crossed, and whether the gray/metal chests ever need keys (keys HUD has only ever shown 0).
